_Requested by **Bill** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wg?thread=cmsg_016iMXWSZDzqWRWvWzdNo8wgHk7ekKESwMTSQFaCgEU8bn)_

Follow-up to #28045 (merged `cdbf08d1`): the three should-fixes of its last contract review, [6524319651](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/28045#issuecomment-6524319651), which could not be pushed to #28045 because the branch was locked in the merge queue ([6524373920](https://github.com/objectstack-ai/objectstack/pull/28045#issuecomment-6524373920)). Part of #28130. Fixes nothing.

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：只改 ADR-0146 一个文件，20 行措辞：D3/D4 里四个关键符号改成 `path#symbol` 锚点（让 `check:adr-symbol-anchors` 真正守住）；Rollout 第三期「三张 Setup 管理页」改成 D7 实际写的两张（队列成员随 ADR-0142 D2）；Rollout 开头的 epic 句子去掉标签快照和 PR 号。
- 为什么改：#28045 最后一轮契约审查（PASS）的 S13–S15；当时分支被合并队列锁住推不上去，已在 PR 上说明会另开本 PR。
- 风险与回滚：纯文档，不改任何决定；回滚即 revert。
- 先看：diff 全部 20 行。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check`、`node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs`、`node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs` 本地全过（锚点 2845/148 records）。
- 需要你做的：`docs/adr/**` 是 Tier H，hand-merge；你对 ADR-0146 的审阅意见也可以直接压在这个分支上。

## What changes

- `docs/adr/0146-studio-designs-setup-administers-one-editor-per-item-paired-customize-package.md` — S13: `catalog-scope.ts#walledCatalogReadOnly`, `useTenancyPosture.ts#useTenancyPosture`, `activation-gate.ts#refuseUngrantedActivationWrite` (D4 authority bullet) and `namespace-prefix.ts#deriveNamespaceFromPackageId` (D3 doors clause) are cited in anchor form; S14: Rollout 3 counts "the two Setup administration pages D7 names (queue membership arrives with ADR-0142 D2)"; S15: the Rollout opener reads "Tracked by epic #28130, blocked on this record's merge".

## Why

The review found the record carried zero `path#symbol` anchors, so the symbol gate held none of its claims (a misnamed hook rode through an earlier head for that reason); Rollout 3's count disagreed with D7; the epic sentence snapshotted a label that drops at the merge. None of the three changes a decision.

## Verification

- `node scripts/adr-index.mjs --check` → OK.
- `node scripts/check-adr-links.mjs` → 944 relative link destinations resolve.
- `node scripts/check-adr-symbol-anchors.mjs` → 2845 anchors across 148 records resolve (the four new ones included).
- Docs-only, no changeset (`skip-changeset`).

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

- [x] 7. No hand edits to `content/docs/references/`, `packages/*/CHANGELOG.md` or `content/docs/releases/`.
- [x] 8. Title, body and comments are in English. (the 速读 block is the project's maintainer-facing convention)
- [x] The *Before Submitting* list in CONTRIBUTING.md is done.
